newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel supply tighter, premiums steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel supply tighter, premiums steady.

text.p: NWE jet fuel cargo supply was tighter and premiums were steady to slightly firmer, traders said on Friday.
Traders reported difficulty in finding larger cargoes and said parcels of more than 10,000 tonnes would cost more than Dec IPE +$32, around $1 firmer.
They said availability had shrunk partly because more jet fuel was going into blend for low sulphur diesel.
Benchmark Dec IPE futures firmed $4 to $223. Barges were Dec IPE +$28/29, unchanged.
